entry.title: Seattle Mariners staff and front office: Mariners involved a select number of players in managerial search. Story, unlocked and free to read: www.nytimes.com/athletic/776...

Seattle Mariners offseason notes: Stephen Vogt was asked directly about his status and the rumors connecting him to the Mariners' managerial opening during the Guardians end-of-season media availability today. “I'll be in Cleveland,” Vogt said. “I'm here. I'm coming back.”
